mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_erp_integration WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_code=#{providerCode}
SELECT FROM dms_erp_integration WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND enabled=1
SELECT FROM dms_erp_integration WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_erp_integration SET integration_name=#{integrationName}, enabled=#{enabled}, environment=#{environment}, endpoint=#{endpoint}, app_key=#{appKey}, app_secret=COALESCE(#{appSecret,typeHandler=com.macro.mall.distribution.security.EncryptedStringTypeHandler},app_secret), callback_token=COALESCE(#{callbackToken,typeHandler=com.macro.mall.distribution.security.EncryptedStringTypeHandler},callback_token), remark=#{remark}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_secret, callback_token FROM dms_erp_integration WHERE (app_secret IS NOT NULL AND app_secret != '' AND app_secret NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%') OR (callback_token IS NOT NULL AND callback_token != '' AND callback_token NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_erp_integration SET app_secret=CASE WHEN app_secret IS NOT NULL AND app_secret != '' AND app_secret NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%' THEN #{appSecret,typeHandler=com.macro.mall.distribution.security.EncryptedStringTypeHandler} ELSE app_secret END, callback_token=CASE WHEN callback_token IS NOT NULL AND callback_token != '' AND callback_token NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%' THEN #{callbackToken,typeHandler=com.macro.mall.distribution.security.EncryptedStringTypeHandler} ELSE callback_token END WHERE id=#{id} AND ((app_secret IS NOT NULL AND app_secret != '' AND app_secret NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%') OR (callback_token IS NOT NULL AND callback_token != '' AND callback_token NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%'))
